# The Compilation Flow

Compilation in Synesis happens in phases, ensuring the formal and conceptual integrity of the body of knowledge.

In the syntactic phase, the compiler checks that blocks are properly opened and closed and that each file follows the grammar of the language.

Then comes the semantic and linking validation. The compiler checks that:

* items are associated with declared sources, and sources with the bibliography;
* the fields used exist in the template, in the right scope, with the declared type and requirement;
* fields grouped in a `BUNDLE` appear paired;
* codes used in items have a concept defined in the ontology;
* chain relations are the declared ones and arity is respected;
* the hierarchy and the labels of the organizing model are consistent (when there are `ROLE` lines).

All these criteria — field names, types, requirements and relation rules — come from the template file, which users adapt to their methodological parameters. The order of fields inside a block is free.

This layered process ensures that outputs are structurally sound and that the body of knowledge stays consistent and computationally reliable. It does not judge the reading: whether the source supports what was annotated is the researcher's call.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    %% --- COLORS (Synesis 2.0 palette) ---
    classDef compiler fill:#fff,stroke:#084C54,stroke-width:3px,color:#084C54,font-weight:bold;
    classDef highValue fill:#E0F7FA,stroke:#00BFA5,stroke-width:2px,color:#084C54;
    classDef defaultNode fill:#F8FAFC,stroke:#4A5568,stroke-width:1px,color:#084C84;
    classDef bridge fill:#F1F5F9,stroke:#00BFA5,stroke-width:1px,color:#084C54,font-weight:600;

    %% --- LAYER 1: ENTRY POINT ---
    P["Project (.synp)<br/>project entry point"]:::defaultNode

    %% --- LAYER 2: INPUTS ---
    subgraph Input ["Input Files"]
        direction LR
        D["Template<br/>(.synt)"]:::defaultNode
        A["Sources<br/>(.bib, .toml)"]:::defaultNode
        B["Annotations<br/>(.syn)"]:::defaultNode
        E["Ontology<br/>(.syno)"]:::defaultNode
    end

    %% --- LAYER 3: COMPILER ---
    C["Synesis Compiler<br/>• Parsing • Validation <br/>• Linking • Export ."]:::compiler

    %% --- LAYER 4: OUTPUTS ---
    subgraph Output ["Output Formats"]
        direction LR
        F["JSON"]:::defaultNode
        G["CSV / Excel"]:::defaultNode
        H["Alpaca / OKF / SKOS"]:::defaultNode
    end

    %% --- LAYER 5: API/BRIDGE ---
    subgraph Bridge ["Interface Layer"]
        direction LR
        API["Compiler API ."]:::bridge
        S["synesis-graph"]:::bridge
    end

    %% --- LAYER 6: ECOSYSTEM ---
    subgraph Ecosystem ["Application Ecosystem"]
        direction LR
        I["Graphs<br/>Neo4j • ArcadeDB • HTML"]:::highValue
        J["AI Agents<br/>MCP"]:::highValue
        K["Data Science<br/>R • Python • Jupyter"]:::highValue
    end

    style Input fill:transparent,stroke:#4A5568,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:5 5
    style Output fill:transparent,stroke:#4A5568,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:5 5
    style Bridge fill:transparent,stroke:#4A5568,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:5 5
    style Ecosystem fill:transparent,stroke:#4A5568,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:5 5

    P ==> Input
    Input ==> C
    C ==> Output
    C ==> API
    API --> S

    D -. "defines structure" .-> B
    D -. "defines structure" .-> E
    A -. "referenced in" .-> B

    Output -.-> K
    S --> I
    I --> J
    API --> K

    linkStyle default stroke:#64748B,stroke-width:1.5px;
```
